people.name: FAIRSERVIS, Walter A., Jr – Persons of Indian Studies by Prof. Dr. Klaus Karttunen

relations.subject: Walter A. Fairservis, Jr.
relations.evidence: For a while he was at University of Chicago on an athletic scholarship (he listened there to Olmstead), but in 1941 returned to New York

relations.subject: Walter A. Fairservis, Jr.
relations.evidence: enrolled in the anthropology program at Columbia University, earning a B.A. adding Chinese and Mongolian to his languages.

relations.subject: Walter A. Fairservis, Jr.
relations.evidence: After the war Fairservis re-entered Columbia University, where he earned an M.A. in anthropology in 1948.

relations.subject: Walter A. Fairservis, Jr.
relations.evidence: Now he moved to Harvard, to the anthropology Ph.D. Program... his degree was postponed and finally conferred only in 1958.

relations.subject: Walter A. Fairservis, Jr.
relations.object: American Museum of Natural History (New York)
relations.evidence: American Museum of Natural History (New York), where he was in 1948-52 Special Field Assistant in Archaeology

relations.subject: Walter A. Fairservis, Jr.
relations.object: American Museum of Natural History (New York)
relations.evidence: and in 1952-62 Special Assistant in Anthropology.

relations.subject: Walter A. Fairservis, Jr.
relations.evidence: with his first Afghan Expedition, a reconnaissance in Pakistan and southern Afghanistan, in collaboration with his friend —> Louis Dupree.

relations.subject: Walter A. Fairservis, Jr.
relations.object: Thomas Burke Memorial Washington State Museum
relations.evidence: In 1962-68 Fairservis served as Museum Director in Thomas Burke Memorial Washington State Museum

relations.subject: Walter A. Fairservis, Jr.
relations.evidence: and Associate Professor of Anthropology at University of Washington.

relations.subject: Walter A. Fairservis, Jr.
relations.object: American Museum of Natural History in New York
relations.evidence: In 1968-76 he was Curator of Anthropology in American Museum of Natural History in New York

relations.subject: Walter A. Fairservis, Jr.
relations.role: Professor of Anthropology and Director of Asian Studies Program
relations.evidence: and from 1968 also Professor of Anthropology and Director of Asian Studies Program at Vassar College.

relations.subject: Possehl
relations.evidence: Among his students were Possehl and several others.
